About

For the last 10 years, I have gained extensive hands-on experience building HACCP plans for meat and meat products, cell-cultivated meat, dairy products, and biotechnology-derived proteins. I've prepared documentation and evidence of food product compliance with EU, FDA, and other specific regulatory requirements, ensuring entry into the relevant market.

With this expertise, I help small and medium-sized companies review, create, and develop their HACCP plans — ensuring their food products, food additives, or ingredients comply with their targeted market's regulatory requirements. I know exactly what each regulatory body expects from food exporters and importers.

I'm passionate about bridging my scientific background with real-world applications to solve the quality and regulatory challenges SME companies face. Having worked across both Europe and Asia — particularly on novel food regulatory approvals in different geographies — I've gained dynamic experience in understanding different markets and regulatory strategies. My expertise spans microbiological and toxicological risk assessment, risk management, HACCP development, regulatory dossier writing, GMP, and total quality management systems.

HACCP GMP / GHP FSSC 22000 ISO 22000:2018 BRC / IFS Regulatory Compliance Audit Management FDA FSMA / PCQI
